requiredInstallationBundles.owner: Platform infrastructure and independent storage/security owners
requiredInstallationBundles.needed: Actual eligible existing non-AWS resources, original key/epoch/KEK mappings, pinned OpenBao metadata and credential mounts, independent authority/archive enrollment, physical all-copy non-revival and survivor-recovery originals. OpenBao deletion alone is insufficient. Ciphertext-only cross-key migration is unavailable; the implemented holder flow additionally requires independently current holder/transport/closure admission and exact retained native outcomes.

Pre-enrolled Dapr strong-CAS heads and immutable retained archives outside application backup/restore; actual replicas, failure domains, genesis/incarnations, completion reserve, retention and two-person recovery authority. Runtime creates no genesis.

Distinct P-256 role/public anchors, installed service profiles and signing mounts, current grants/revocation and Dapr app-channel credentials; separate authorizer/control/observer and qualification executor/observer/enrollment placements. All supplied bytes must match accepted pins.

Installed restricted EventStore bound-command proof source, native authoritative reader, independent original authority, exact replay/security-log stream/event ACLs, durable replicated denial spool, recovery authority and worker installation. Source composition does not install or activate these.

All fourteen actual host slots and five service installations at 192.168.1.30, Branch B identity/tenant/Parties/Conversations bindings and independently issued decision authority; child owning-process composition and FR-34 engine/observer bindings.

requiredInstallationBundles.owner: EventStore Maintainer and independent protection owners
requiredInstallationBundles.needed: Complete immutable protection source/package/locked graph, installed accepted profile/roles/trust, real engine and persisted-reader ports, G1-G7 closure, physical non-revival and survivor recovery originals, complete accepted owner command. Guarded transactions additionally require a dedicated outside-restore exact-original store/credential and actual independently enrolled cell/receipt scopes; fully restored state plus absent native receipt before any independent commit witness stays Unknown.

Externally provisioned SQLite schemas/current accepted set and service enrollment on independently durable storage, authenticated phase owners and persisted observer, pinned exact phase command artifacts, current signed owner readiness, complete configuration/profile/plan/anchor/image inventories and independent installation proof. No source test provisions production enrollment. Required metadata-only recovery argv uses the same pinned shipped executable with --phase-finalize, current retained-attempt read authority and exact immutable case files; no effect command may substitute during recovery.

Explicit coordinated replacement Platform/protection dates and immutable complete targets based on actual installed readiness; complete replacement acceptance and executable commands afterward. No replacement date or target is inferred.

Current independently accepted bounded parent recipe and exact native original root slots or explicitly mapped existing occurrences; distinct actual pre-admitted write/read KeyUse inputs; separate claim/read-use role credentials and durable indexed archives; current recipe hash, native registration/holder/copy-completion witnesses and replenishment inputs. Source bounds are 128 roots and 32 reads per root, never installed capacity. Fresh logical canaries retain the actual original native target. Unknown release/completion or exhausted/missing pools deny new release. Requires an explicitly independently current common FR34 authorization revision and exact immutable original reserved-manifest mapping, including static cases. No fr34:<random-id> reservation is inferred.

ordinarySourceCorrectionsRemaining.evidence: CustodyOwnerOperationHandler only implements Methods/Handle. Default IsReadOnly=false and default RecoverAsync throws; stable DaprCustodyOwnerCallSource payloads therefore admit once then reject repeated read-current/verify framing. The handler itself reads current/control originals and signs framing, rather than executing the owner transition.
ordinarySourceCorrectionsRemaining.route: patch — correctly classify framing and verify repeated actual receiving calls

ordinarySourceCorrectionsRemaining.evidence: Runner sets attempt_state=ReservationUnknown before reserve but leaves the earlier signed-absence effect state NotDispatched. Another coordinator may already have reserved/dispatched when this response is lost; the failure then reports zero.
ordinarySourceCorrectionsRemaining.route: patch — set conservative effect uncertainty before reserve and test the race

ordinarySourceCorrectionsRemaining.evidence: FR34 RecoverAsync delegates to HandleAsync for unseal/replay. Their actual unprotect paths call the material provider; after a prior holder completes, retry can allocate another read profile and produce a later outcome under the admitted original.
ordinarySourceCorrectionsRemaining.route: patch — exact retained/native result or Unknown, without another read release

ordinarySourceCorrectionsRemaining.evidence: Lifecycle Execute retains any non-null actual outcome; delivery Execute likewise retains Unknown/Unavailable. Both Lookup methods return that case-result before consulting native originals, permanently sealing transient uncertainty even when completion is later readable.
ordinarySourceCorrectionsRemaining.route: bad_spec — preserve pending uncertainty separately and settle only exact terminal originals, retaining legacy evidence

ordinarySourceCorrectionsRemaining.evidence: Wrap execution serializes CustodyKeyRegistration, but missing outer-result recovery serializes client.LookupOriginalAsync's CustodyKeyLifecycleOutcome under the same actual field. Equal request identity can therefore recover a different result schema/body.
ordinarySourceCorrectionsRemaining.route: patch — recover the verified original registration representation or remain Unknown

ordinarySourceCorrectionsRemaining.evidence: recording-command-authorize checks Workload(caller,principal,domain), while both dispatch-admit branches only test original-store caller/bytes/Unsent. The checked workload identity/principal is not bound into dispatch; its revocation can win between proof and dispatch without being checked at CAS.
ordinarySourceCorrectionsRemaining.route: bad_spec — bind/revalidate exact workload authorization at dispatch admission

ordinarySourceCorrectionsRemaining.evidence: NativeDaprAuthorityStore publishes archive/checkpoint objects before conditional head commit, using GUID locators. CompletionReserveBytes only reduces serialized checkpoint allowance; no physical free-space reservation or pending completion accounting exists in this store. Failed CAS leaves additional charged physical objects.
ordinarySourceCorrectionsRemaining.route: bad_spec — surviving physical completion/publication accounting and stable native archive retry

ordinarySourceCorrectionsRemaining.evidence: JointPhaseSourceOperationHandler recovery calls Handle/Publish again. If no final file exists after an admitted failed publication, the publisher rereads current guard/protection/streams and signs those later facts as the original phase observation. There is no retained first observation body to recover.
ordinarySourceCorrectionsRemaining.route: bad_spec — immutable inner native measurement publication or Unknown

ordinarySourceCorrectionsRemaining.evidence: Both installation readers call File.ReadAllBytesAsync before checking bytes.Length. Their stated bounds do not prevent oversized allocation or nonregular-path stalls; no upstream bounded descriptor acquisition protects these entrypoints.
ordinarySourceCorrectionsRemaining.route: patch — bounded regular-file acquisition with a finite deadline before allocation

ordinarySourceCorrectionsRemaining.evidence: Preflight obtains four independent readiness receipts sequentially; each call may take under 30 seconds while their combined elapsed time exceeds the authority's 30-second receipt window. Reservation rejects otherwise healthy complete inputs.
ordinarySourceCorrectionsRemaining.route: patch — acquire independent readiness as a bounded fresh set

ordinarySourceCorrectionsRemaining.evidence: Independently confirms the same owner-framing default recovery failure as B6-1 through the actual interface defaults and stable caller payload.

Receiver sends every already-admitted replay-register-exact request only to LookupAsync. The actual RegisterAsync contains guarded retained-unsent/definitive-native-no-event recovery, so the outer retry never reaches that permitted recovery branch.
ordinarySourceCorrectionsRemaining.route: patch — reach exact guarded registration recovery while unknown dispatch remains lookup-only

ordinarySourceCorrectionsRemaining.evidence: Matching publication reservations permit concurrent exact retries. ImmutableFileArchive writes a full unique temporary file before checking the final path and has no per-path writer ownership. Duplicate large copies can consume multiple times the single reserved write budget, including across receiving instances.
ordinarySourceCorrectionsRemaining.route: bad_spec — bounded cross-instance exact publication ownership/deduplication preserving atomic durability

ordinarySourceCorrectionsRemaining.route: patch — actual adapter/client/receiving proof and current-revocation regression
